_about: The web tool's own settings: the only list of parameters written by hand. Everything else (names, defaults, help, choices, presets, modes, formats) is read from Generator/parameters/*.py and kese/job.py when the page starts.
_hidden: Not shown and not imported: folders of a desktop run, the terminal status line, the custom font file (the web has only KiCad's font), and the preset table (offered as the Preset buttons).
_forced: How the browser runs KESE: one worker (there are no threads), no status line.
_desktopOnly: Shown greyed out with a note: the settings of threads and worker processes, which the browser's single-core Python cannot use yet. Their values stay as in the files, also in Export.
desktopOnlyNote: Uses threads and worker processes: support in the browser is in the works. The browser runs KESE on one core; the desktop program is roughly 6 to 10 times faster on the example boards.
_outside: Shown outside the sections: Mode is the big switch, the file formats are the Download switches, Verify sits beside Generate.
_units: The run's length unit, for the board size under the preview.
_basic: Basic: one section per parameter file, in KESE's order. Geometry, Colorization, Parallel and Verifier are in Advanced only. Advanced shows every parameter, these included.
_whenFormat: A section shown only while its file format is ticked under Download, in Basic and Advanced alike (its values are kept while hidden).
_crossSection: How the cross-section draws the cut faces: "stencil" (SectionStencil.js, drawn by the GPU in every frame), "geometry" (SectionGeometry.js, the exact section worked out on the CPU, a step behind the slider) or null (the cut without faces).
_basicOpen: Sections open when the page starts. None: every section shows closed, so all are in view and the visitor opens what they need.
_titles: Section titles. Run is called Output on the page.
_preview: Which generated file the preview opens first in each mode, when several were made.
